hook: Daniela Amodei runs the day-to-day operations of Anthropic, the AI safety company she co-founded with her brother Dario in 2021 after both left OpenAI. Her path there ran through Capitol Hill and international development work before she spent years at Stripe, helping grow the company from about 40 employees to more than 300 and later working on platform risk with engineers, ML specialists and lawyers. At OpenAI she focused on AI safety and policy before deciding to help start a company built around that idea from the ground up. As President, she describes her job as taking the technical safety vision of Anthropic's research leadership and turning it into concrete operating norms for the company.
